# Chartize

Chartize is a GGSQL workspace for querying, exploring, and visualizing public datasets. It combines a read-only DuckDB and Parquet warehouse, direct-manipulation chart tools, and an optional grounded AI collaborator.

- [Explorer](/explore): build and inspect visualizations.
- [About](/about): product and privacy overview.
- [GGSQL language reference](https://ggsql.org/llms.txt): query and visualization syntax used by Chartize.
